title: Treasure Not Found
paragraphs: The next day.
“We’ve arrived.”
We reached the village that Father had governed in the first world.

Thanks to the Queen, slaves had gathered here in droves! There’s a lot to do, but if we proceed with development the same way Father did in the first world, everything should be fine. By the way, we’re planning to go with the Queen to a fortress where the Three Hero Church is secretly hiding evidence and thoroughly expose it. The necessary permissions have already been secured.
“…We’ve finally made it back,” Big Sister muttered softly, looking around at the now-abandoned village.
“Starting today, we’ll begin developing this place.”
“Looks like it. It’s hard to say if it’ll become a proper base, though…”
“According to Motoyasu-san, it’s a location that’s easy to operate from, so let’s do our best.”
“For now, I guess securing food will be the priority? If we have some leeway, we can repair… or even rebuild the houses.”
“Come to think of it, the procurement of the bioplant has been delayed.”

The bioplant was lost last time because of Takt’s remnants. Father had made excellent use of it in the first world. With the doctor’s cooperation, we can accomplish a lot. It would be best to ask if the doctor can be relocated to this village without causing the kind of rampage that happened last time.
“I’ll go get it later.”
“Then I’ll leave that to you, Motoyasu-kun.”
“Hero-dono, is it true that you know about the future?”

Ah yes, I almost forgot, but Éclair is accompanying us. This morning, when we were preparing to head to the village, the Queen introduced her to us. I’ll skip the self-introductions since they’re a hassle. Éclair, having given a perfectly formal bow, was assigned by the Queen to join us in the effort to rebuild the territory.
“Eclair-san, are you taking care of the neighboring town?”
“Yes. I’ll be returning to Father’s estate and immediately focus on the reconstruction efforts. Under the Queen’s command, we have ample manpower and support. We also have Melty-dono’s cooperation.”
“Of course, I’ll assist as well.”

Fiancée is surprisingly quiet. In the first world, I recall her being quite noisy. Oh? She’s holding hands with Sakura-chan. How many times do I have to tell her that I won’t allow her to get along with Sakura-chan while neglecting Filo-tan?
“Good luck. We’ll send over some of the bioplants that Motoyasu-kun brings back when the time comes.”
“Much appreciated.”
Saying that, Éclair left with the soldiers accompanying her and headed toward the neighboring town.
“Shield Hero-sama, if there’s anything you need for the development, please let me know. I’ll contact Mother immediately.”
It seems we’ll have plenty of resources from the kingdom. The reconstruction might progress faster than it did in the first world.
“Yeah, thanks. For now… I’d like to ask the higher-level ones to take the lead in helping with the development.”
Following Father’s instructions, big sister and the others, with Keel at the forefront, let out a cheer. It’s a bit noisy. Well, at least they’re motivated.
“Melty-chan, you’re also at a decent level, right? Can I ask you to help too?”
“Of course, I’ll do it. Right, Sakura… big sister?”
“Yeah. I’m kind of happy.”

Sakura-chan hugged Fiancée from behind. Fiancée returned her smile. Come to think of it, in the previous loop, Fiancée admired the grown-up Sakura-chan like a big sister. They really do seem like sisters. In that case, I suppose I can let it slide this time. Since it doesn’t seem like cheating.
“What about the ones with lower levels? Are we going to take them to level up?”
“Could I ask you to do that? As long as it’s not too much trouble. If their base abilities are higher, it’ll improve efficiency.”
“Yeah, that’s true. First, leveling… then resources. Since it looks like Motoyasu-san will handle that, today’s priority should be building facilities to shelter us from the elements.”
“Oh my… then what should I do?”
Big sister’s big sister asked Father while tending to the slaves.
“Could you keep an eye on everyone? Make sure no one gets too tired, especially Raphtalia-chan.”
“Got it.”

By the way, the Filolials are also helping with the development. And just like that, the first day passed without any issues. I procured the bioplant, modified it, and planted it. With this, the food situation should gradually improve. Come to think of it, the village isn’t just guarded by the Filolials. I should consider buying more monsters later. The next day.
“Motoyasu-kun, what should we do today? According to the plan, it’s time to gather materials.”
“Hmm…”
Let’s see… I’m recalling what Father instructed last time. Ah, yes.
“We’re going to Zeltoble.”
“Huh? Do you have some business there?”
“Securing funds would be one thing, but this time, it’s for something else. It was a request from the Queen last time.”
“Then, should we meet with the Queen? Shouldn’t we all go together?”
“That’s fine. Please ask her to lend us a medical facility. But this time, I can handle it alone. Father and the others should continue with the development along with big sister.”

And so, after meeting with the Queen once… I headed to the monster merchant in Zeltoble. I had heard the details from Ren, Itsuki, and Panda. This was the Queen’s request. I made my way to the underground market beneath the grand coliseum.
“Well, well, isn’t this your first time here? Yes, nice to meet you. Welcome to my slave market.”
“Fi—”
Whoa, I almost said Filo-tan out of reflex. I must hold back. Filo-tan isn’t here. I showed the monster merchant the letter of introduction from the broker recommended by the Queen.
“Oh! You must be the Spear Hero! What business brings you to my slave market today? Yes.”
The monster merchant in Zeltoble spoke with a slight excitement, rubbing his hands together.
“I’m here to buy slaves.”
I know they’re here.
“Yes. What kind of slaves are you looking for?”
“A pair of Hakuko siblings. I heard the younger one is sickly.”

And so, I purchased the Hakuko siblings and half-forced the younger sister to take Yggdrasil medicine. When I approached her, the younger sister murmured something about me being ‘someone wrapped in a maddening whirlwind of love.’ Yes… I am the Love Hunter, driven mad by my love for Filo-tan, yet I manage to maintain my sanity. The older brother was noisy at first, but after I gave him work and medicine, he agreed to serve as a mercenary and carry his sister around. As they say, if a deal seems too good to be true, it probably is. We agreed that his sister would stay at the clinic for treatment, and if he was worried, he could stay with her as much as he liked. After leaving the Hakuko siblings at the clinic in Melromarc, I returned to the village and decided to go hunting deep in the mountains with Yuki-chan to make some money. However, no matter how far we went, we couldn’t find any dragons or treasure in the mountains.

Strange. They had always been there before, but this time, nothing. With no other choice, I went to the mountains of another country to hunt and brought back the spoils. The funds from this would be used not only for the Filolials but also for the development of the village. I returned two days later by carriage with the Filolials from the other country.
“Ah, welcome back, Motoyasu-kun!”
Father and the others had been steadily making progress with the development.
“Hey, the spear guy’s back!”
Oh? Keel has returned to his dog form. He’s finally back.
“Check me out, spear guy! Pretty cool, huh?”
“Luna-chan will be happy. She really loved you in many ways.”
“Who the heck is Luna-chan!? And what do you mean by ‘in many ways’!?”

Keel curled up, crossing his arms protectively. Luna-chan is Luna-chan. That Luna-chan really cared about Keel. Last time, she was Mole, though. Speaking of which, what should I do about Mole? I’ll ask Éclair to take care of that later.
